description: Named generator configurations used for repeated solver, replay, and human playthrough QA. A case is approved only after its blocking issues are fixed and it has been replayed from the recorded seed. Cases are generated independently of play profile and normally approved under the Scarcity mastery projection.

evaluation_principles.rule: Fix generator, runtime, or test invariants across the corpus; never branch gameplay behavior on a seed or case id.
A required beat and the exit can complete only after their preceding required change, unless a completed source explicitly activates a generated bypass route.
The briefing, HUD, rewards, and simulation must derive from one normalized play configuration and describe the same active economy.

Generate each seed once. Difficulty and ATP-drain profiles project pressure onto that same spec and must not add, remove, move, replace, or retune its geometry, actors, resources, rewards, routes, prerequisites, or solutions.

Scarcity is the preferred approval run. A deterministic ideal-resource-management persona must reach the exit under Scarcity; deliberate, legible losses are allowed, but an easier-profile pass cannot approve a Scarcity failure.

For the same generated spec, roster, and action trace, each easier profile may only reduce or disable pressure. A trace that completes under Scarcity must remain completable under every easier profile.
Optional travel and danger must buy proportionally stronger physically carried lysate; mandatory spine travel must never mint abstract ATP breadcrumbs.
Deterministic golden, shadow, and risky personas must traverse legal route prefixes and suffixes instead of teleporting around prerequisites.
Approve a case only after machine contracts, deterministic live play, rendered configuration, and human readability pass, then verify the same rules on a structurally different seed.

cases.label: Channels baseline
cases.purpose: First-stretch teaching baseline and visibility/causal-feedback regression case.
acceptance_focus: The first causal relationship is readable without outside explanation.
Every conscious party member contributes visibility throughout the stretch.
Interactable outlines, hotspots, and their affected world objects agree.
blocking_issues: Visibility collapsed for the whole party after reaching the second generated node.
The cistern target outline and the apparent interaction hotspot did not agree.
Route markers did not make the first cause-and-effect chain sufficiently legible.

cases.label: First fork
cases.purpose: Teaching-tier fork: establish one causal choice, a visible consequence, and a short recovery loop.
acceptance_focus: A novice can state what the fork changes before committing.
The alternate route is a decision rather than decorative topology.
A failed prediction visibly suggests the next experiment.
blocking_issues: Final approval still needs a novice-controlled readability pass for the fork; the prior mechanical blockers now pass deterministic and rendered QA.
playtest_notes: Required-node and shelter progression now reject out-of-order completion without seed-specific logic.
The maintained corpus deliberately tests the experimental scarcity preset: after first movement, each character loses 1 ATP every 60 seconds down to zero; a later zero-ATP tick costs 5 HP.
Shelter completion now has visible confirmation and disables repeat completion.
The rendered briefing reports the active drain values; detour lysate remains physical, carried, and deliberately endocytosed, while shelter rest still costs one ATP.

cases.label: Flora patrol walk
cases.purpose: Standard-tier causal transfer across flora, patrol, carry, and reconstruction beats.
acceptance_focus: Each beat changes the setup of the next beat.
The player recognizes transferred relationships instead of servicing disconnected rooms.
The solved-state execution tail stays short.
blocking_issues: The opening is spatially broad and low-contrast: the local entry reads on hover, but the first downstream beat is not visually dominant without scanning.
A human-paced pass still needs to judge ten-node resource pacing and whether the five salvage detours read as choices rather than route noise.
playtest_notes: Machine analysis and deterministic golden, shadow, and risky-recovery runs pass under the shared experimental scarcity plus physical-lysate/rest configuration.
The risky persona exposed a harness teleport assumption; it now walks the legal prefix, rejoins the main route, and completes the legal suffix.

cases.label: Garden patrol
cases.purpose: Standard-tier timing and patrol manipulation case with a different generated topology.
acceptance_focus: The patrol rule can be inferred before the high-cost commitment.
Flora is a leverage point rather than a collectible detour.
Pressure creates anticipation without hiding causal evidence.
playtest_notes: The July 18 streamer replay reached shelter in 68.22 seconds and crossed one 60-second scarcity interval, but that timing is historical evidence only: current approval remeasures elapsed simulation and requires an observed drain tick rather than trusting this note.
Generated targets now name concrete actions and reserve prediction/intervention dwell time, while the random walk limits consecutive and overall archetype repetition.
The entry party uses the shelter's open face, causal links render above the party overlay stack, and null-material outline copies are covered by a focused regression.
Risk buys an optional reward detour instead of skipping mandatory causal beats; its cost is previewed and lands as a visible NEAR MISS before recovery.
All six maintained seeds pass machine analysis plus deterministic golden, risky-recovery, and shadow playthroughs under the shared generator rules; no seed-specific gameplay tuning was applied.

cases.label: Ferric carry chain
cases.purpose: Hard-tier typed causal chain: every solved state must become the next puzzle's setup.
acceptance_focus: The output of each link is visible at the next link.
The nested plant problem is genuinely inside the carry problem.
Aster and Peris retain a costlier but legible shadow solve.
playtest_notes: The generator now emits two complete four-link cycles; every cycle-scoped output feeds a later input, including cycle crossover and the final shelter handshake.
Both nested carry hosts require a visible preparation interaction, then place separate payloads in Aster and Peris's hand slots; shelter records two delivered payloads.
The 26-HP risky detour pays a carried 3-ATP lysate, creating a reserve-versus-exposure decision under the explicitly selected scarcity clock.
The shadow replay moves only Aster and Peris, marks Endo outside the active party, uses pair-specific solutions, and still delivers both payloads.
Rendered replay QA and all six maintained live seed playthroughs pass under the shared generator rules.

cases.label: Containment setpiece
cases.purpose: Setpiece-scale stress case for causal legibility, recovery, and pacing contrast.
acceptance_focus: The setpiece still has one readable current question at a time.
Failure identifies a wrong prediction rather than merely inflicting runback.
Scale does not turn solved reasoning into repetitive traversal.
